notes.text: Black already has an advantage, with passed pawns on a3 and d3 backed by two bishops. The played 49.Rba1 gives way to 49...Ba4+ and a stronger attack. The local Stockfish Lite prefers 49.Rf2, keeping the rook active and offering more resistance; it does not change the reported game result.
